integrity: A complete mathematical proof, explicit dependencies, and exact standalone arithmetic checks are supplied. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The distributional density is an n-to-infinity limit for each fixed integer b and fixed polynomial f, and the total-variation comparison takes b to infinity only after that limit.
The theorem assumes an irrational nonconstant coefficient; rational polynomials are not covered.
No numerical bound on convergence in n or independent certification is asserted.
The infinite step uses an external published large-prime theorem; exact finite checks test only arithmetic reductions.
Bibliographic originality is qualified by the possibility of unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Exact gcd spectra of rationally coupled polynomial floors
